svg.title: How cadxfer changes a BDF mesh and its surrounding data
svg.desc: A schematic BDF quad mesh branches into three outputs. The BDF copy has identical geometry and records. The edited BDF moves one mesh node but keeps other records. The VTU retains the original geometry and IDs while solver records are omitted and reported.
svg.text: One preserved BDF source. Three different output guarantees.
Same mesh. Every source byte retained.
One node moved. Other fields retained.
Same geometry and IDs; omissions reported.
Schematic mesh: the copy and VTU keep source geometry; only the edited BDF moves a node.
